build.buildCommand: pnpm --filter @workspace/bet62 run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && (pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium || pnpm exec playwright install chromium)

deploy.startCommand: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(find /nix/store -maxdepth 2 -type d -name lib 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ':')$LD_LIBRARY_PATH; NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
